subject: Disableing MathJax Zoom in shiny app

messages.author: a2b67ba83149045c
messages.subject: Disableing MathJax Zoom in shiny app
parts:
Hi Everyone:

New to the group.

I've created a shiny app with ggplot.
Is there a way to disable the mathjax zoom when the browser window is resized?
The automatic resizing is making the application less responsive and slow.



Thanks,
Dan

messages.author: a2b67ba83149045c
messages.subject: Re: Disableing MathJax Zoom in shiny app
parts:
Wanted to answer my own question for other people in the future.

the `renderPlot` function has a parameter for `width` and `height` that are set to 'auto' by default.

You can give it a value (in pixels) to have the plots not resize itself when the browser window is resized.
There is also a `res` (for resolution) that is set to 72 by default

A sample of using the `width` and `height` parameters:

    output$facet_plots <- renderPlot({
        plots_facet[1]
    }, width = 825, height = 600)


- Dan
